annotations.title: Look up growing season length for a place

description: Frost-free season length and seasonal growing degree days at any place, and whether heat-loving crops get enough heat to ripen. Works without a Siltwell account. For the signed-in user's own garden, get_plan returns the microclimate-adjusted frost dates that bound its season, and get_history returns its daily growing degree days.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Give it with longitude instead of place.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Give it with latitude instead of place.

place.description: Town plus region or country, for example "Portland, Oregon". Omit it to use the signed-in user's garden.

name: lookup_growing_season
title: Look up growing season length for a place
